source.original_question:
There is an isosceles triangle. Find the area of the figure.
Choices:
A:30
B:60
C:120
D:240

adaptations.reason: Decorative triangle fill removed; source base dimension arrows replaced by protocol dashed distance range.

independent_solution.method: The altitude of the isosceles triangle bisects the base: h=sqrt(13^2-5^2)=12. Area=10*12/2=60.
